title: Winey Beef Teriyaki Wrap
description: A fusion of Japanese and Argentinian flavors, this dish combines the sweetness of winey beef with the tanginess of lemon and the crunch of a crispy wrap.
instructions: 1. Slice the beef into thin strips and season with soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame seeds.
2. Heat a pan with a little oil and sear the beef for 2-3 minutes.
3. In a separate pan, combine the winey glaze, ginger, and water to make the teriyaki sauce.
4. Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until it thickens.
5. Add the beef strips to the teriyaki sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes until coated.
6. Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap with the beef, green onions, and a drizzle of the teriyaki sauce.
9. Slice the lemon into wedges for garnish.
10. Sprinkle with sesame seeds for extra crunch.
